Model_6.name: Dual PCC + LP Unidirectional Driving Hubs

model_averaged_inclusion_probability.interpretation: Dense Model 1 probability P_M1 > 0.998 ensures all 30/30 extrinsic edges survive Pp > 0.95 threshold.

hub_vs_nonhub_dispersion_audit.conclusion: Empirical standard deviations across PCC (0.227 Hz), LP (0.214 Hz), and non-hub edges (0.210 Hz) show no significant difference (all p > 0.40), proving zero-preserving scaling sigma_full does not bias hub edge ranking.

regime_a_strict_sparsity.description: Strict binary sparsity (0.00 Hz background); Occam bonus correctly identifies true sparse models.

regime_b_graded_hierarchy.description: Graded biological hierarchy (sigma_bg = 0.065 Hz); within-subject accuracy losses exceed prior shrinkage.
